title: Setup Doc and tools doc (two Google Docs)
source: The owner's two docs, fetched as text and read in full (5373 and 3898 bytes). Dossiers by `python -m faceless intake`; Etsy MCP read with Exa. Nothing installed or run. Entries already decided on 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-12 were not repeated.

items.name: GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server)
items.why: MIT. This session already runs GitHub through the hosted GitHub MCP, scoped to this repo; the studio's own `GITHUB_TOKEN` works. Nothing to install in the engine.
items.steal: Toolset scoping (only the tools a job needs).

items.name: GitHub Copilot SDK
items.why: MIT, but it embeds Copilot's agent runtime and needs a Copilot seat. We run Claude; a second agent runtime adds cost and a key with no stage it improves.

items.name: Browser Use SDK (npm, PyPI, GitHub)
items.why: MIT, cloud browser agent. Key `BROWSER_USE_API_KEY` works but holds $0.0 credit, and the studio already has TinyFish (works) and Photopea headless for browser jobs. Revisit if a task needs a logged-in browser nothing else can drive.
items.owner: Top up credit only if a job needs it.

items.name: Tripo C# SDK (tryAGI/Tripo)
items.why: MIT, wrong language, and the studio's `TRIPO_API` key is rejected (code 1002). No 3D in the money-education look.
items.owner: Replace the Tripo key if 3D is wanted later.

items.name: Tripo Python SDK
items.why: MIT, official. Parked with the Tripo MCP: key `TRIPO_API` fails authentication and no pillar needs 3D assets.
items.owner: Replace the Tripo key if 3D is wanted later.

items.name: v0 SDK (vercel/v0-sdk)
items.why: Apache-2.0. `V0DEV_API` works. Useful for generating site UI, but the Money Rules Library is generated by `site.py` in code we review, so a model-built UI would add unreviewed markup (rule 14). Could draft a hub-page design once.

items.name: Monid CLI and SKILL (monid-ai/monid)
items.why: MIT. Pay-per-use data endpoints; `MONID_API_KEY` works with $9.71 balance. Already recorded 2026-10-08 as a marketplace; the CLI itself is a binary installer so the desk would call its HTTP API directly, like Muapi, behind a cap.
items.steal: Endpoint catalogue for search-volume and social-search data.
items.owner: Say go to wire a capped desk.

items.name: Monid plugins
items.why: MIT, unpinned run lines. Nothing beyond the CLI.

items.name: AgentQL MCP (tinyfish-io/agentql-mcp)
items.why: HIGH flag: install hook. Last change 2026-02. TinyFish's own MCP is already connected and works, so this adds nothing.

items.name: cli-anything-tinyfish
items.why: Third-party wrapper over a vendor we already reach through its official MCP and key. No reason to trust a stranger's wrapper.

items.name: tinyfish (PyPI)
items.why: Official SDK for the TinyFish service we already use through the connected MCP; key works. Use the MCP in sessions. No engine code needed until a routine needs it headless.

items.name: muapi-python (SamurAIGPT)
items.why: MIT. The Muapi desk already calls the API directly under a cap and the muapi-cli npm package was killed for a postinstall binary. Same vendor wrapper adds nothing.

items.name: opencode-firecrawl
items.why: Plugin for the OpenCode agent, which we do not run.

items.name: firecrawl/cli
items.why: Same verdict as 2026-10-12: HIGH flags (install hook, pipe-to-shell, secrets). Firecrawl is reachable through the connected tools and Exa instead.

web.name: Etsy official MCP (mcp.api.etsycloud.com/mcp)
web.why: Hosted by Etsy (etsycloud.com is Etsy's). It needs no key but only serves the Open API v3 endpoint and schema details; it does not call the API or touch a shop. Use it as a read-only reference while we write the Etsy rail against the spec. Nothing to install: add the URL as an http MCP in a session if wanted. Listing creation still needs ETSY_API_KEY plus the one-time login.
web.steal: The schema lookup, so request bodies are right the first time.
web.owner: Create the Etsy app and run `python -m faceless etsy auth`.

web.name: Vercel MCP (mcp.vercel.com)
web.why: Hosted, OAuth, for managing Vercel projects. The site deploys from GitHub Actions; `VERCEL` key works if needed. No job today.

web.name: Vercel AI SDK (ai-sdk.dev)
web.why: TypeScript library. Engine is Python and calls providers through its own interface, so it adds a second runtime for nothing.

web.name: LiquidAI system-one-arcade (HuggingFace space)
web.why: A demo space. Not a tool, no API, nothing for money education.
